title: Sponsor Services Desk Guidance: One Open PBM Services Agreement per Plan Sponsor
content:
A plan sponsor holds at most 1 PBM Services Agreement that is not terminated. A change of pricing arrangement is made at renewal by amendment of the same agreement, never by a second agreement. A new agreement may be signed only when the sponsor has no agreement that is pending implementation, active or termination pending.

## The rule as the desk applies it

| Status of the sponsor's existing PBM Services Agreement | May a new agreement be signed for that sponsor? |
|---|---|
| Pending implementation | No |
| Active | No |
| Termination pending | No |
| Terminated | Not barred by this rule |
| The sponsor has no agreement on record | Not barred by this rule |

The test is made against the system's agreement records for the same plan sponsor, before the new agreement is signed: it is the status shown on the records, not the sponsor's own description, that decides. Agreements held by other sponsors play no part.

## Changing pricing arrangement

A sponsor that wants a different pricing arrangement does not sign a second PBM Services Agreement. The change is made at renewal, by amendment of the agreement it already holds; the agreement stays one agreement throughout.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- *Hypothetical:* a sponsor's agreement shows termination pending, and the sponsor wishes to sign a fresh agreement on another arrangement. The existing agreement is not terminated, so a new agreement may not be signed while that status stands.
- *Hypothetical:* a sponsor's only agreement shows terminated. This rule places no bar on a new agreement.
- *Hypothetical:* a sponsor's agreement is pending implementation and the sponsor asks for a second one to run alongside it. At most 1 agreement that is not terminated may be held, so the second is not signed.
